{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Heave to, rabid gropers ob the Holy ob Holies! Id is now we are blasting you to molecules, to be delayed only for the abount of seconds id takes for you to turn ober the Prime Mover frob your vile clutches!|An Ugor|<ref name="SH">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>}}
The '''Holiest of Holies''' or '''Holy of Holies''' was a chunk of wreckage from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] that was recovered by [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] scavengers shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|technology|gravitywellprojector|gravity well projector}}.</ref><ref name="SH" /> The salvage contained a prototype [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]] that the Ugors' [[priest-scientist]]s discovered could be used to order the chaotic spread of garbage in the Ugor's home, the [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]]. After this discovery, the projector was dubbed the [[Prime Mover]], and the wreckage in which it was housed was called the Holy of Holies or Holiest of Holies.<ref name="DB" /><ref name="SH" />

An Ugor cordon of [[Black Hole-class Salvage Dreadnought|''Black Hole''-class Salvage Dreadnoughts]] patrolled the area surrounding the wreckage and its holy component. The Holiest of Holies had a mass of 40,000 tons. It certainly looked like wreckage; visitors were greeted with a patchwork of destroyed conduits, deck supports, and hallways. Because its outer surface was completely destroyed, it was not easily identifiable as coming from the Death Star.<ref name="SH" />

Inside the hunk of space station, artificial gravity allowed for normal movement. Nevertheless, there was no [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], so [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] were required. Visitors found the shadows and echoes of the interior somewhat disconcerting. Imperial matériel, such as [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] and [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], was scattered willy-nilly throughout the corridors. Among the surviving chambers in the wreck were a garbage compactor and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal quarters and [[Meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chamber]] (complete with a spare cloak and helmet). [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals could still detect a residual evil in this area. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] also survived and could be found in the wreckage.<ref name="SH" /> The gravity well projector lay at the center of the hulk in a high-ceilinged chamber with broken [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] viewports.<ref name="SH" />

The rubbish was inhabited. For one, a group of malfunctioning automata known as [[Void Droid]]s roamed the wreckage. Desperate for power cells and spare parts, they attacked anyone who entered the holy site. A diseased and injured [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] lived in the remains of a garbage smasher.<ref name="SH" />

When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] eventually located the debris and captured the gravity well projector, the Paradise system devolved back into chaos.<ref name="SH" />
